title: Show HN: Inillucent – agentic db written in Rust that is 500% faster than SQLite

item.text:
Hi HN!

I built an embedded db in Rust, that has 100% feature parity with SQLite, and is 500% faster overall than SQLite.

It also features built in integration with embedding models, embed functions, vector search, reranker, and other RAG capabilities.

It's 100% free and open source.

I'd love to hear back from the community, and find some collaborators who are interested in working together!

https://github.com/Black-Rainbow-Labs/Inillucent

SEARCH
A Perfect Database for your Agentic Workflows
The perfect featureset to support your Retrieval Augmented Generation needs. When you're searching through a corpus of Confluence documents, Slack messages, JIRA tickets, and Figma designs, you need the ability to search by meaning, and not just exact phrase matchings. Our vector support allows you to use an embedding model and store vectors and perform similarity searches, order by vector distance cosine, etc.

Ask a question your documents can't answer and most search hands back its ten closest matches anyway. They look exactly like ten good ones, and an agent will write a confident paragraph out of them. We give every result a confidence score, calibrated on questions that do have answers, so a result below the threshold is dropped and the search can come back empty.
